checks.caption: Figure 3.2: Four sensory worlds: infrared, ultraviolet, infrasound, and geomagnetic cues.
checks.alt: Four pencil-style scenes show a pit viper sensing infrared radiation from a warm mouse with its facial pit; a bee beside matched flowers in visible light and false-colour ultraviolet, revealing a dark petal-base pattern; Asian elephants with low-frequency sound waves; and a European robin beside schematic geomagnetic field lines.
